ski_area: Chamonix Mont-Blanc (Brévent-Flégère, Grands Montets, Balme, Aiguille du Midi)
opening_source_note: actumontagne 25-Nov-2025 + official Le Pass rate periods; 2026/27 alti-mag provisional list
piste_km_basis: Chamonix Le Pass (official; Grands Montets summit excluded)
score_notes: Former FWT venue; Vallée Blanche, Grands Montets and Brévent couloirs; Haute Route start with Compagnie des Guides/ENSA make it a world touring hub.
comments: Via Mont Blanc tunnel (no extended closure in 2026, only autumn night closures); Col des Montets may close for avalanche risk. Aiguille du Midi 3842 m = lift-served glacier off-piste (Vallée Blanche, Mont Blanc Unlimited pass), cable car closed 2 Nov-18 Dec 2026; marked pistes top out at 2765 m (Bochard) while Grands Montets summit 3275 m stays closed until Dec 2027 (new Argentière-Lognan gondola due summer 2026, Plan Joran gondola reopens 5 Dec 2026). 2025/26 opened 29 Nov (Grands Montets Plan Joran/Bochard/Tabé + Flégère), Brévent and Balme 13 Dec, Les Houches 6 Dec. Dynamic online pricing from 47 EUR off-peak; 74 EUR = peak ticket-office price 20 Dec-27 Mar; Mont Blanc Unlimited 1 day 100 EUR. skiresort.com sums valley areas incl. Les Houches to about 169 km.

opening_source_note: official forfait.megeve.com opening page (Cote 2000 pre-opening; general opening 19 Dec 2026)
piste_km_basis: Evasion Mont-Blanc pass (official claim; skiresort.com measures 185 km Megève/St-Gervais)
score_notes: Mainly groomed-piste resort; limited off-piste at Cote 2000/Mont Joly; modest local touring (Mont Joly, Aiguille Croche).
comments: Base = Rochebrune cable car and car park. Route via Mont Blanc tunnel-Sallanches. 2025/26: exceptional Cote 2000 opening 29-30 Nov 2025 (25 EUR day), Mont d'Arbois 8-12 Dec, general 20 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 5-6 Dec (Cote 2000, Mont d'Arbois), general 19 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027. Price = Evasion Mont-Blanc 1-day haute saison 2026/27 (65 EUR; 12-18 Dec 52 EUR) as published by the Saint-Gervais and Portes du Mont-Blanc lift-co sites; Megève 2025/26 PDF was 63.50. Top 2353 m = Mont Joly (Saint-Gervais sector), Megève's own sectors are lower; bergfex quotes 1113-2350 m and Evasion 445 km.

opening_source_note: lift-co openings page (13 Dec partial) + SMB listing; 2026/27 alti-mag + tariff periods
piste_km_basis: Evasion Mont-Blanc pass (official claim; skiresort.com 185 km Megève/St-Gervais)
score_notes: Mont Joly/Epaule offers some off-piste; touring modest (Mont Joly, Col du Joly); no guide-culture hub.
comments: Base = Le Bettex (1400 m) gondola station and car park (incl. Saint-Nicolas-de-Véroce sector); alternative valley gondola Saint-Gervais-Le Bettex from town. 2025/26 partial 13-19 Dec then general 20 Dec 2025 (year not printed on lift-co page; matches 2025 calendar and SMB listing 13 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026). 2026/27 Evasion tariff: intermediate period 12-18 Dec 2026 (52 EUR) then haute saison from 19 Dec (65 EUR); alti-mag lists 19 Dec 2026-4 Apr 2027. Les Houches-Saint-Gervais (Prarion/Bellevue) is a separate Chamonix-side area not on this pass.

ski_area: Les Portes du Mont-Blanc / Evasion Mont-Blanc
opening_source_note: PdMB lift-co: weekends 6/7, 13/14 Dec then 20 Dec 2025; 2026/27 official dates page
piste_km_basis: Portes du Mont-Blanc pass (official; skiresort.com 85 km)
score_notes: Low gentle family area (Tête du Torraz 1930 m) with little off-piste; only easy touring nearby.
comments: Base = Beauregard chairlift/La Cry car park (Route des Brons, lift-co office). Evasion Mont-Blanc pass also sold (65 EUR 2026/27, 400 km). 2025/26 weekend openings 6/7 and 13/14 Dec were planned per lift-co, not separately verified (bergfex lists season from 20 Dec 2025); closed 22 Mar 2026. 2026/27: 19 Dec 2026-21 Mar 2027. La Giettaz and Cordon are on the same pass.

opening_source_note: official news 3-Dec-2025 (pre-opening 6-7 Dec); 2026/27 lift-co tariff page (partial 5 Dec)
score_notes: Good lift-served off-piste (Col du Joly, Aiguille Croche, Nant Rouge); strong touring (Dômes de Miage, Tré-la-Tête, Col de la Fenêtre) inside the nature reserve with an active guide office.
comments: Base = Télécabine du Lay (main car park); Télécabine de la Gorge is the second base (works summer 2026). 2025/26: partial 6-7 Dec and 13-19 Dec, general 20 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 5-6 Dec and 12-18 Dec, general 19 Dec 2026-10 Apr 2027. Elevation: lift-co states 1164-2500 m, bergfex 2487 m, skiresort.com 2437 m. Also on the Evasion Mont-Blanc pass (65 EUR 2026/27). Route via Mont Blanc tunnel-Saint-Gervais.

opening_source_note: bergfex season start 29 Nov 2025 + visiter-laclusaz (Balme pre-opening); 2026/27 date not yet published
score_notes: Balme sector hosted FWQ freeride events; Combe de Borderan/Fernuy off-piste; Aravis touring classics (Pointe Percée, Trou de la Mouche, Combe des Aravis).
comments: Base = Bossonnet lift and car park in the village. From Italy via Mont Blanc tunnel-Sallanches-Col des Aravis (normally kept open, may close in heavy snow) or A41 Annecy. Dynamic pricing: Prem's online 29.90-49.90 EUR (49.90 = max, bought 2+ days ahead) vs 56.50 EUR window price (2025/26 tariff still displayed; 2026/27 not yet online). 2025/26 pre-openings 29-30 Nov (Balme) and 6-7 Dec; continuous 13 Dec 2025-26 Apr 2026. Elevation: skiresort.com 2485 m; official/aggregators quote 2500-2600 m. Manigod on same pass.

opening_source_note: bergfex/alti-mag: weekend 6-7 Dec then 13 Dec 2025; 2026/27 alti-mag provisional (closing matches lift-co page)
piste_km_basis: Le Grand-Bornand pass (official OT 90 km; alti-mag 84, bergfex 86)
score_notes: Lachat/Almet off-piste is limited; good Aravis touring access (Pointe Percée north side, Col des Annes, Pointe d'Almet).
comments: Base = Le Chinaillon (1300 m) ski-village car parks; village gondola (Rosay) lower. Col de la Colombière closed in winter (approach via Thônes/Saint-Jean-de-Sixt). 2025/26 dates (6-7 Dec weekend, continuous 13 Dec 2025-10 Apr 2026) are planned dates from aggregators, not separately verified. 2026/27: 12 Dec 2026-11 Apr 2027; day pass 52 EUR (official 2026/27 tariff).

opening_source_note: official flaine.com pre-opening page + grand-massif.com; 2026/27 official flaine.com winter openings page
piste_km_basis: Grand Massif pass (official; Flaine-only pass also sold)
score_notes: Gers bowl, Désert de Platé and Grandes Platières off-piste are well known; touring mostly Platé plateau/Tête Pelouse day tours.
comments: Base = Flaine Forum/Front de Neige car parks (via Cluses, A40; from Italy via Mont Blanc tunnel). 2025/26 pre-opening 29-30 Nov 2025 (Aup de Véran sector), official 6 Dec 2025-19 Apr 2026. 2026/27: 5 Dec 2026-18 Apr 2027 (5-18 Dec subject to snow). Local Flaine-only pass 60.70 EUR (2026/27); Grand Massif 63 EUR (+2 EUR keycard). Top: official 2500 m (Grandes Platières), skiresort.com 2480 m.

opening_source_note: flaine.com news (Les Carroz/Samoëns 13 Dec 2025 planned); 2026/27 official lescarroz.com
piste_km_basis: Grand Massif pass (official; Villages pass also sold)
score_notes: Tree-lined intermediate area with some off-piste towards Gers/Tête des Saix; modest local touring.
comments: Base = Kédeuze gondola in the village. 2025/26 planned opening 13 Dec 2025 (Grand Massif general opening) to 12 Apr 2026; actual first day not separately verified. 2026/27: 12 Dec 2026 (official). Villages pass (Carroz/Morillon/Samoëns/Sixt) 58.50 EUR 2026/27, km not published; 2500 m top is in Flaine (Grandes Platières).

opening_source_note: samoens.com (Grand Massif 13 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026); 2026/27 alti-mag provisional
piste_km_basis: Grand Massif pass (official; Villages pass also sold)
score_notes: Off-piste towards Gers/Vernant; Haut-Giffre and Sixt-Fer-à-Cheval touring (Criou, Col de Joux Plane) give good local touring.
comments: Base = Grand Massif Express gondola at Vercland (700 m), 2 km from the village; Sixt-Fer-à-Cheval is a linked village. Col de Joux Plane (to Morzine) closed in winter. 2026/27: alti-mag lists 19 Dec 2026 but Les Carroz (same lift company) publishes 12 Dec 2026 - double-check. Villages pass 58.50 EUR (2026/27), km not published.

piste_km_basis: Grand Massif pass (official; Villages pass also sold)
score_notes: Gentle family sector (Morillon 1100, Coulouvrier 2120 m); little off-piste or touring of note.
comments: Base = Morillon village gondola (700 m) to Morillon 1100. Sector top 2120 m (Coulouvrier chair); 2500 m is the Grand Massif top in Flaine. 2025/26 planned 20 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026, actual not separately verified. 2026/27 alti-mag provisional 19 Dec 2026 (Les Carroz official 12 Dec). Villages pass 58.50 EUR. Official morillon.fr redirects to haut-giffre.fr (certificate error), so the Grand Massif multi-cam page is used for the webcam.

opening_source_note: bergfex season start 13 Dec 2025 (official 20 Dec, pre-opening possible); 2026/27 Pléney desk dates
score_notes: Nyon/Chamossière offer some steep off-piste; touring modest (Roc d'Enfer, Pointe de Nantaux nearby).
comments: Base = Pléney cable car in the village. From Italy via Grand-Saint-Bernard/Martigny-Monthey-Pas de Morgins or Geneva-Thonon; Col de Joux Plane closed in winter. 2025/26: official 20 Dec 2025-6 Apr 2026 with pre-opening 13-19 Dec possible (bergfex season from 13 Dec); Avoriaz reachable from 12 Dec via Prodains. 2026/27: Pléney desks from 21 Nov, Nyon from 19 Dec 2026; Les Gets lift-co lists partial 12 Dec/general 19 Dec 2026 - Morzine partial date not published. Prices web 50/desk 56 EUR until 19 Mar 2027 (Saturdays 40); Portes du Soleil 69 web/73 desk (+3 EUR card). Top 2019 m (Pointe de Nyon) per bergfex; skiinfo 2000 m.

opening_source_note: press + resort (29-30 Nov 2025 pre-opening, 21.50 EUR day); 2026/27 official avoriaz.com ski-area page
piste_km_basis: Portes du Soleil pass (official 600 km; skiresort.com 580 km)
score_notes: Hauts Forts, Fornet and the Swiss Wall/Chavanette give strong lift-served off-piste; touring limited (resort-based).
comments: Car-free resort: drive to the paid entrance car parks at 1800 m (coordinates given) or park at Les Prodains (46.18893, 6.75595) and take the Prodains Express cable car. 2025/26: pre-opening 29-30 Nov and 6-7 Dec 2025, official 12 Dec 2025-19 Apr 2026. 2026/27: 11 Dec 2026-18 Apr 2027. Avoriaz-only pass 43-55 EUR (dynamic, 2026/27), km not published; Portes du Soleil 69 EUR online/73 desk until 19 Mar 2027 (+3 EUR card). Top: skiresort.com Portes du Soleil lift-served 2254 m; marketing quotes 2466 m (Hauts Forts summit). Access from Italy via Pas de Morgins or Geneva-Thonon.

opening_source_note: bergfex + morzine-avoriaz.com (20 Dec 2025); 2026/27 official pass.lesgets.com (partial 12 Dec, general 19 Dec)
score_notes: Family/intermediate area (Mont Chéry, Chavannes); little serious off-piste or touring.
comments: Base = Chavannes lifts/front de neige (underground Chavannes car park). Pre-opening 13-19 Dec 2025 was possible but not confirmed; official 20 Dec 2025-12 Apr 2026. 2026/27: partial 12 Dec, general 19 Dec 2026, closing 11 Apr 2027. Prices web 50/desk 56 EUR (Saturdays 40); Portes du Soleil 69/73. Top 2002 m per bergfex/skiinfo (Les Gets side); Morzine side 2019 m. score_notes: Linga north faces and Cornebois off-piste; valley touring to Mont de Grange/Cornettes de Bise.

Espace Liberté 55 EUR high season (47 off-peak/late season); Portes du Soleil 69 EUR; online rates lower than desk. Top 2200 m per skiinfo; bergfex quotes 2466 m (summit).
